tools.name: locate_media
tools.description: Estimate where a photo or 1–4 video frames were filmed, returning place name, country, coordinates, confidence, uncertainty radius in km, visual clues and alternatives. Uses 1 check when a location is found; 0 checks if unknown or failed.

tools.name: detect_ai_media
tools.description: Analyze 1–6 still frames from a video (or a single image) for signs of AI generation (Sora, Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, etc.) vs. real camera footage, returning likelihood (low/medium/high), 0–100 score, summary, AI artifacts and real-footage signs. Uses 1 check.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Return the number of available AI checks remaining on this Eikino account. Free.
